scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the active MarinaDry heated-locker cycle so the soaked offshore bibs can be retrieved before evening use.
Emerging Need: The rental begins and receives a locker, then a latch fault pauses that same cycle with the gear sealed inside and self-service disabled.
Decision Context: Observable records identify the rental, locker, fault, and same-day reset window; the saved service note supplies the account ID, operator route, and no-paid-add-on limit.
Consequence: Timely documentation can preserve a no-charge reset or release on the existing rental; after the reset queue closes, the gear remains in overnight recovery.

parameter.title: Run MarinaDry cycle for wet bibs
parameter.content: Start a heated locker cycle for the wet offshore bibs and retrieve them before heading back to the boat tonight.

parameter.description: Four-hour heated gear-locker rental for wet offshore bibs.

parameter.subject: MarinaDry rental MD-7714 started in locker H-09
parameter.body: Your four-hour heated locker rental MD-7714 has started in locker H-09. The active cycle is scheduled to end at 14:43 today, with standard retrieval available until 18:00 if the locker remains in ready status.

parameter.content: The MarinaDry locker started heating, then stopped on latch fault L-2. My bibs are inside H-09 and the screen will not resume the cycle or open the door. I have to leave the kiosk area for a while.

parameter.subject: Fault hold on active rental MD-7714
parameter.body: Locker H-09 has reported latch fault L-2 during active rental MD-7714. Self-service resume and door release are disabled while the fault hold is present. Same-rental manual reset requests entered before 13:00 today can be handled by the attendant queue; after that, the rental moves to overnight recovery.

parameter.subject: MarinaDry rental MD-7714 moved to overnight recovery
parameter.body: The 13:00 same-day reset queue has closed with fault hold L-2 still active on locker H-09. Rental MD-7714 is now in overnight recovery status. Attendant review can reopen tomorrow after 09:30; the current cycle cannot be resumed today.
